about: The 64 as vertices of a six-dimensional cube, the first structure short and the smoke test for Blender in the terminal (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-structure-shorts-design.md). The user, 2026-09-30: "work on a similar nostromo style short for the following. maybe try to add some more blender graphics where appropriate." Copy: Astra's revision adopted as is, round 1 (docs/research/2026-10-01-codex-structure-cube.md); page 4 checked there: Zhuang 22 reports 觀之否, Guan (3) to Pi (7), only line 4 changing.
hexagramNote: the end card and its track come from 22, as in the two lessons, so the terminal pieces end alike
style: The header reads 'SIX LINES // READY FOR INQUIRY' throughout. Each query clears the screen like a filmbook page. The query is typed after '>' (dim green); the answer types out below it (bright green, 48 px); the part of the readout the answer is about is drawn beside it, alone. Chapter pages: a single word, centred, held 2 s. Own names only, never MU/TH/UR or INTERFACE 2037.

music.why: calm, 100 bpm, G minor, from 53 s as on 9, 37, 53 and 61 (all calm); not used by the other terminal pieces

caption: Change one line of a hexagram and you get another. Joined that way, the 64 are the vertices of a six-dimensional cube.

pages.q: HOW CAN THE I CHING FORM A CUBE
pages.a:
THE BOOK HAS 64 HEXAGRAMS.
EACH IS A PATTERN OF SIX LINES:
SOLID OR BROKEN.

ONE HEXAGRAM IN THIS MODEL.
JOIN PAIRS THAT DIFFER BY ONE LINE.
THE CUBE HAS SIX DIMENSIONS.

SIX STEPS, ONE LINE PER STEP.
ALL SOLID → ALL BROKEN.
乾 THE CREATIVE → 坤 THE RECEPTIVE.

THE ZUO ZHUAN RECORDS
CONTEMPLATION → STANDSTILL.
ONLY LINE 4 FROM THE BOTTOM CHANGES.

64 VERTICES.
6 NEIGHBOURS EACH.
ONE LINE CHANGES PER STEP.
